animaze.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to Animaze.

animaze.disconnected.description: Runs when the connection to Animaze drops, for example because you closed it.

animaze.avatarChanged.description: Runs when Animaze switches to another avatar, whoever switched it (you, Cuebot or another app).

fields.avatar: Only react to these avatars. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.

variables.previousAvatar: The avatar before (empty if Cuebot did not know it)

fields.avatar: The avatar's name, as Animaze lists it. Connect first to pick from the list.

animaze.loadScene.description: Switches the background scene behind your Animaze avatar.

fields.scene: The scene's name, as Animaze lists it.

animaze.emote.description: Plays an emote on your Animaze avatar, like Angry or Alarm.

fields.emote: The emote's name. Connect first to pick from your avatar's emotes.

variables.animaze.emote: The emote's item name that Animaze played

animaze.specialAction.description: Plays one of the current avatar's special actions, like waving hello.

fields.action: The special action's name, or its number.

animaze.pose.description: Puts the current avatar into one of its poses.

fields.pose: The pose's name, or its number.

animaze.idle.description: Changes how the current avatar moves while idle.

fields.idle: The idle animation's name, or its number.

animaze.quickscene.description: Loads one of your saved Animaze quickscenes (avatar, background and settings together).

fields.quickscene: The quickscene's name, or its number.

animaze.virtualCamera.description: Turns Animaze's virtual camera on or off. That camera is how other apps, like OBS or Discord, see your avatar.
